categories.name: Tinnitus relief
categories.blurb: Broadband sound to soften the contrast between silence and ringing. Set the volume just below your tinnitus, never above it.

categories.name: Solfeggio tones
categories.blurb: Pure tones from the Solfeggio scale, popular in meditation and sound-bath practice.

categories.name: Golden ratio
categories.blurb: Tones spaced by the golden ratio (1.618), cascading in one by one and resetting every few seconds. Best on headphones.

categories.name: Binaural beats
categories.blurb: A slightly different tone in each ear. Your brain hears the difference as a slow pulse. Headphones required.

categories.name: Tuning
categories.blurb: Single reference tones for relaxation and musical practice.

frequencies.name: White noise
frequencies.about: Equal energy at every frequency. The brightest of the noises, good for masking high-pitched ringing and busy rooms.

frequencies.name: Pink noise
frequencies.about: Softer in the highs than white noise, so it sounds like steady rain or wind. A common choice for tinnitus sound therapy and for sleep.

frequencies.name: Brown noise
frequencies.about: Weighted towards low frequencies, with a deep rumble like a waterfall or the inside of a plane. Many people find it the most relaxing to sleep to.

frequencies.name: Ocean swell
frequencies.about: Pink noise that rises and falls every ten seconds or so, like waves on a shore. Gentler on the ear than steady noise for long sessions.

frequencies.name: 174 Hz
frequencies.about: The lowest Solfeggio tone. Listeners often use it as a warm, grounding drone at the start of a session.

frequencies.name: 396 Hz
frequencies.about: Traditionally linked with releasing tension and worry.

frequencies.name: 528 Hz
frequencies.about: The best-known Solfeggio tone, often called the love frequency. A bright, clear tone used widely in meditation music.

frequencies.name: 528 Hz sound bath
frequencies.about: 528 Hz layered with soft harmonics and a slow shimmer, closer to a singing bowl than a pure tone.

frequencies.name: 639 Hz
frequencies.about: Traditionally linked with harmony and relationships.

frequencies.name: 741 Hz
frequencies.about: Traditionally associated with clarity and expression.

frequencies.name: 852 Hz
frequencies.about: A high, airy tone traditionally linked with intuition and stillness.

frequencies.name: 963 Hz
frequencies.about: The highest Solfeggio tone. Keep the volume low: high tones feel louder than they look.

frequencies.name: Golden 528
frequencies.about: Thirteen tones spaced by the golden ratio around 528 Hz. They enter one by one from the top down, hold, then reset every seven seconds, alternating between your left and right ear.

frequencies.name: Golden 432
frequencies.about: The same golden-ratio cascade built on 432 Hz, a little lower and warmer than 528.

frequencies.name: Golden 396
frequencies.about: A golden-ratio cascade on 396 Hz, the Solfeggio tone traditionally linked with letting go.

frequencies.name: Golden drift
frequencies.about: A slowed-down golden 528 cascade with soft edges. Each tone drifts in a second apart over a fourteen-second cycle. Gentle enough to fall asleep to.

frequencies.name: Deep sleep
frequencies.about: A 2 Hz beat over a 150 Hz tone. Delta rhythms are the brain's slowest, seen in deep sleep. Use lying down with headphones.

frequencies.name: Meditation
frequencies.about: A 6 Hz beat over a 200 Hz tone. Theta rhythms appear in light sleep and deep meditation.

frequencies.name: Schumann resonance
frequencies.about: A 7.83 Hz beat, matching the main electromagnetic resonance of the Earth's atmosphere. A favourite for calm, grounded meditation.

frequencies.name: Calm focus
frequencies.about: A 10 Hz beat over a 220 Hz tone. Alpha rhythms are linked with being awake but relaxed, eyes closed.

frequencies.name: Deep focus
frequencies.about: A 40 Hz beat over a 300 Hz tone. 40 Hz gamma stimulation is an active research area.

frequencies.name: 432 Hz
frequencies.about: A slightly lower A than the modern 440 Hz standard. Many listeners describe it as warmer and softer.

plus.name: Hertzspace Plus
perks: Download any frequency to your device
